description: World Bank indicator across countries — One World Bank indicator for up to 30 countries in one call, ranked: each country's latest value and year, 5-year and 10-year change, 10-year compound growth and the last 11 years of data, plus max, min and median. indicator= a World Bank code (e.g. NY.GDP.PCAP.CD) or a short name: gdp, gdp_per_capita, gdp_growth, population, inflation, unemployment, life_expectancy, exports, imports, debt, fdi, internet, urban, co2_per_capita, gini, poverty, fertility, electricity_access, military, rnd. countries= ISO codes separated by commas. Source: World Bank Open Data (CC BY 4.0). Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: econ_worldbank_batch
